items.title: Tesla (TSLA) Targets 1 Million Optimus Robots A Year
items.summary: Tesla (NasdaqGS: TSLA) CEO Elon Musk outlined a target of producing 1 million Optimus humanoid robots per year, tying the company's long term focus more tightly to robotics. Musk said Optimus could eventually account for about 80% of Tesla's value and suggested this shift could position Tesla as the world's most valuable company.
